title: TranSiGen generative model supports phenotype-based drug repurposing in pancreatic cancer
summary: TranSiGen is a deep generative model with self-supervised representation learning that reconstructs chemical-induced transcriptional profiles from basal gene expression and molecular structure. Its representations were applied to virtual screening, drug response prediction and phenotype-based repurposing, and in vitro validation in pancreatic cancer drug discovery is reported.
